scope: Complete upstream installer result; image registration and managed runtime acceptance remain separate

states.id: cmd_|-remnux-config-inetsim-netdns-loop-once-present_|-perl -MNet::DNS::Nameserver -e 'die q{Net::DNS::Nameserver->loop_once() is gone; INetSim DNS patch needs rework}'_|-run

cmd_|-remnux-config-opencode-x64dbg-commands_|-for f in /opt/x64dbg-skills-opencode/commands/x64dbg-*.md; do
  install -o remnux -g remnux -m 644 "$f" /home/remnux/.config/opencode/commands/
done
_|-run

cmd_|-remnux-mozilla-key-fingerprint_|-echo "Mozilla's APT key at /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.mozilla.org.asc is not the single key with fingerprint 35BAA0B33E9EB396F59CA838C0BA5CE6DC6315A3. Deleting it." >&2
rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.mozilla.org.asc
exit 1
_|-run

cmd_|-remnux-packages-firefox-ubuntu-purged_|-set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --allow-downgrades --download-only firefox
dpkg --purge --force-remove-reinstreq firefox
apt-get install -y firefox
_|-run

cmd_|-remnux-radare2-r2ai-install_|-r2pm -ci r2ai && r2pm -ci decai && mkdir -p /home/remnux/.local/share/radare2/plugins && echo '6.2.4' > /home/remnux/.local/share/radare2/plugins/.r2ai-radare2-version_|-run
cmd_|-remnux-theme-wireshark-reconfigure_|-echo "wireshark-common wireshark-common/install-setuid select True"| debconf-set-selections; dpkg-reconfigure -f noninteractive wireshark-common_|-run

cmd_|-remnux-tools-x64dbg-docs_|-set -e
rm -rf /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging
mkdir -p /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/tree
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/docs.tar.gz https://github.com/x64dbg/docs/archive/refs/heads/master.tar.gz
tar -xzf /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/docs.tar.gz -C /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/tree --strip-components=1
test -f /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/tree/introduction/Formatting.md
test -f /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/tree/LICENSE
test -d /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/tree/licenses
chown -R root:root /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/tree
find /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/tree -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +
find /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/tree -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +
rm -rf /usr/local/share/x64dbg-docs
mv /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging/tree /usr/local/share/x64dbg-docs
rm -rf /usr/local/share/.x64dbg-docs.staging
_|-run
test_|-manalyze installed via package_|-manalyze installed via package_|-nop
